::: {.lead}
I build agentic systems and work on LLM post-training, evaluation and multimodal document intelligence. Before ServiceNow I did AI research at TotalEnergies and co-founded AiKYNETIX. Off the clock: trail running, coaching youth runners, chess and math puzzles.
:::

## Highlights

::: {.plain-list}
- **StarHarness** — evolving agent harnesses with the model weights fixed: +20–35 points on three enterprise benchmarks. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24804)
- **Are small LLMs ready for coding agents?** — talk at the Agentic AI Summit, UC Berkeley, 2026. [Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N1XoiJGyNpM)
- **Apriel-1.6-15B-Thinker** — agentic-coding evaluation for ServiceNow's open-weight reasoning model. [Release](https://huggingface.co/blog/ServiceNow-AI/apriel-1p6-15b-thinker)
- **pdfmini** — compress and combine PDFs privately, right in the browser. [Try it](https://den-run-ai.github.io/pdfmini/)
:::
